clean_description: Quentin Coldwater, a high school math genius, is admitted to a secret college of magic, fulfilling his childhood dreams of escaping to a fantastical world. However, his experiences reveal the dark and dangerous realities of magic and the fantasy land of Fillory, leading him to confront disillusionment and the consequences of his desires. The novel explores themes of coming-of-age and the complexities of fantasy versus reality.
themes: disillusionment, coming-of-age, the nature of fantasy
setting: modern-day New York and a magical college
